media.prompt: GFPGAN 1.4 restore. Left: the invented adult's face shrunk to 160 px, blurred and saved as a JPEG at quality 30. Middle: GFPGAN's result. Right: the clean original.
media.note: Eyes, brows, lips and hair edges come back sharp and the face still reads as the same invented person, a little rounder and younger. Only the face is redrawn: the collar and background stay as blurred as they came in. On a harsher test (100 px, JPEG quality 18) it redrew the face as a visibly different person, so the template warns about that. Apache-2.0 (GFPGAN), MIT (facexlib).

media.note: One face found at score 0.80; the 106 points sit on the jaw, brows, eyes, nose and lips. Detection and landmarks only: the restore, swap and identity models this family also covers (GFPGAN, CodeFormer, inswapper, PuLID, the w600k recogniser) are not on disk.
